mostWorthwhile.text: Making the epidermal barrier was most worthwhile: it explained both how skin slows water loss and how its outer cells are replaced.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the gland and sensory endings was repetitive, with little explanation added by either result.

surprise.text: The explanation that deeper cells replace cells shed at the surface added a useful sense of skin as renewing tissue.

arbitrary.text: The combinations had clear purposes, but the layered-skin picture was confusing: it described spaces for a gland and nerves while also appearing to show them already in place.

continue.text: I would be mildly interested in another chapter if it explained more connections between structures and their functions; several fittings here felt predictable and added little.
